method_note: Time-boxed sweep (~15 min). 22 names checked against company press releases (mostly via finviz/newswire mirrors of the company's own release, found by WebSearch; URLs below), not vendor calendars. Baselines were not read per name except DUOL. Short interest not sourced for any name in the time available: every short_interest is 'unknown'. trades_on is 'unknown' unless a release-specific fact was found. The other 243 names are listed under 'unchecked' and were not verified in either direction.
